policy.artifact_rule: Every registered local comparison artifact and loader is pinned by repository-relative path, SHA-256, and byte count.
policy.license_rule: Every source has an SPDX-style expression or NOASSERTION with a non-empty explanation.
policy.raw_input_rule: Absent raw payloads are recorded as absent. A citation, edition, or manually transcribed value is never represented as a raw-file hash.
policy.determinism_rule: Loader classifications distinguish deterministic local generators, live-network refreshers, and hash-verifying scorers whose external inputs are not vendored.
